purpose: Prospective, read-only backend and quantization numerical alignment diagnostic. No task dataset, optimizer update, grader or held-out access.
prompt_prefix: Neutral numerical calibration: colors and shapes.
outcome_rule: For a measured arm, require one complete four-action group, finite recorded scores, unchanged pre/post full parameter hashes and differentiated error <=1e-6 nat. Record numerical nonpass explicitly. Unavailable device blocks before checkpoint download, never CPU fallback. A timeout is incomplete; do not reclassify v1 q4.
limitations: Four sampled tokens per arm, short contexts only; a narrowly scoped numerical smoke.
Arms may sample different tokens. No performance/speed comparison or learning claim.
Metal availability is probed, not assumed on hosted virtual machines. Blocked arms have no numerical result.
V1 q4 timeout and v2 measured evidence stay unchanged.
